messages.subject: borders() needs "colour" not "color" parameter
parts:
Hi:

I have been playing with some mapping and just figured out that my
problem with borders() is that it needs "color" to be spelled the
Queen's way.

I could be wrong, but I thought I read that either spelling was
acceptable everywhere in ggplot2.

Thanks!
Jeffrey
